gear-weapon#0083.src: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, {p} Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.
gear-weapon#0083.dst: Korkunç yalnız haydut {p} Luke'un silahı; geleneksel mermiler yerine küçük metal fişekler atmak üzere tasarlanmış olmasıyla eşsizdir.
gear-weapon#0083.flat: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, {p} Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.
gear-weapon#0083._raw: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, Rymek Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.

gear-weapon#0084.src: "We'll ensure that under our watch, all your families will be reunited!" -Haros, of the Banished Legion
gear-weapon#0084.dst: "Bizim nöbetimizde bütün aileleriniz yeniden kavuşacak, bundan emin olacağız!" -Haros, Sürgün Lejyonu'ndan
gear-weapon#0084.flat: "We'll ensure that under our watch, all your families will be reunited!" -Haros, of the Banished Legion

gear-weapon#0085.src: Decay spreads unseen, but you know it spreads, and that is enough.
gear-weapon#0085.dst: Çürüme görünmeden yayılır, ama yayıldığını bilirsin ve bu yeter.
gear-weapon#0085.flat: Decay spreads unseen, but you know it spreads, and that is enough.

gear-weapon#0086.src: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, {p} Citizen
gear-weapon#0086.dst: "O zombilerden birini ilk gördüğümde az kalsın kalp krizi geçiriyordum! Alçaklar korkunç." -Rynend, {p} Vatandaşı
gear-weapon#0086.flat: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, {p} Citizen
gear-weapon#0086._raw: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, Maltic Citizen

gear-weapon#0087.src: This artefact begins deteriorating your flesh from the moment it touches your skin, but its destructive force can be channeled to rot the bodies of any who come near.
gear-weapon#0087.dst: Bu eser tenine değdiği andan itibaren etini çürütmeye başlar; ama yıkıcı gücü yaklaşan herkesin bedenini çürütmek için yönlendirilebilir.
gear-weapon#0087.flat: This artefact begins deteriorating your flesh from the moment it touches your skin, but its destructive force can be channeled to rot the bodies of any who come near.

gear-weapon#0088.src: A dusty old tome, containing all the powers of the abyss. From its pages spring forth the blackest of secrets and the darkest of truths. Do not let yourself slip into its grasp, for it will consume you too.
gear-weapon#0088.dst: Uçurumun bütün güçlerini barındıran tozlu, eski bir kitap. Sayfalarından en kara sırlar ve en karanlık gerçekler fışkırır. Pençesine düşmene izin verme, yoksa seni de yutar.
gear-weapon#0088.flat: A dusty old tome, containing all the powers of the abyss. From its pages spring forth the blackest of secrets and the darkest of truths. Do not let yourself slip into its grasp, for it will consume you too.

gear-weapon#0089.src: One of {p}' buildings was struck by lightning {~} years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.
gear-weapon#0089.dst: {~} yıl önce {p} kasabasındaki binalardan birine yıldırım düştü ve bina yanıp kül oldu; geriye yalnızca parlamaya başlayan tahta bir kiriş kaldı. Bu kiriş, oradaki büyücülere özel bir asaya dönüştürüldü.
gear-weapon#0089.flat: One of {p}' buildings was struck by lightning {~} years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.
gear-weapon#0089._raw: One of Detlas' buildings was struck by lightning 60 years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.

gear-weapon#0090.src: One of the most unstable wands known to man. Using the bark of the Flerisi trunk, it reaps fiery destruction upon its enemies.
gear-weapon#0090.dst: İnsanoğlunun bildiği en kararsız asalardan biri. Flerisi gövdesinin kabuğundan yapılmıştır ve düşmanlarına ateşli bir yıkım yağdırır.
gear-weapon#0090.flat: One of the most unstable wands known to man. Using the bark of the Flerisi trunk, it reaps fiery destruction upon its enemies.

gear-weapon#0091.src: Often, the leader of brute gangs would use this dagger to threaten his followers into making sure they did not fail him.
gear-weapon#0091.dst: Kaba saba çetelerin lideri bu hançeri sık sık takipçilerini tehdit etmek ve onu yüzüstü bırakmadıklarından emin olmak için kullanırdı.
gear-weapon#0091.flat: Often, the leader of brute gangs would use this dagger to threaten his followers into making sure they did not fail him.

gear-weapon#0092.src: Strangers held together by shared past, entwined in a fray, never to unite again.
gear-weapon#0092.dst: Ortak bir geçmişle bir arada tutulan, bir arbedede birbirine dolanan ve bir daha asla birleşmeyecek yabancılar.
gear-weapon#0092.flat: Strangers held together by shared past, entwined in a fray, never to unite again.

gear-weapon#0093.src: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.
gear-weapon#0093.dst: Boşluğun ve karanlığın asi büyüleri bu yayın kirişinde ehlileştirilmiş. O enerjiler asla serbest kalmaz; ama yaydan çıkan oklar öyle göz alıcı bir hızla uçar ki hedefe çarptıklarında varoluştan silinip giderler.
gear-weapon#0093.flat: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.

gear-weapon#0094.src: The world is only as small as your heart makes it out to be.
gear-weapon#0094.dst: Dünya ancak kalbinin onu gördüğü kadar küçüktür.
gear-weapon#0094.flat: The world is only as small as your heart makes it out to be.

gear-weapon#0095.src: Infiltrating a mind is tricky business; warping its thoughts, taking its wishes. It requires precision, skill, and more than a fair bit of luck.
gear-weapon#0095.dst: Bir zihne sızmak çetrefilli iştir; düşüncelerini çarpıtmak, dileklerini almak. Hassasiyet, beceri ve epey de şans gerektirir.
gear-weapon#0095.flat: Infiltrating a mind is tricky business; warping its thoughts, taking its wishes. It requires precision, skill, and more than a fair bit of luck.

gear-weapon#0096.src: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, {p} Glassblower
gear-weapon#0096.dst: "Fırın konusunda pek ilerleme olmaz. Kil, cam, seramik... çoktan mükemmelleştirildi." -Treous, {p} Cam Üfleyicisi
gear-weapon#0096.flat: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, {p} Glassblower
gear-weapon#0096._raw: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, Almuj Glassblower

gear-weapon#0097.src: They say the first sip of the ocean's wrath fizzes like champagne. The second burns with a sharp saltiness. By the third, the bubbles rise from your own drowning lungs as the sea claims its aperitif.
gear-weapon#0097.dst: Okyanusun gazabının ilk yudumunun şampanya gibi köpürdüğü söylenir. İkincisi keskin bir tuzlulukla yakar. Üçüncüsünde ise kabarcıklar boğulan kendi ciğerlerinden yükselir; deniz aperatifini alır.
gear-weapon#0097.flat: They say the first sip of the ocean's wrath fizzes like champagne. The second burns with a sharp saltiness. By the third, the bubbles rise from your own drowning lungs as the sea claims its aperitif.

gear-weapon#0098.src: Sever every last impurity of the self, and bring to fruition a brilliant culmination of 'you'.
gear-weapon#0098.dst: Benliğindeki son katışıklığı da kes at ve parlak bir 'sen' doruğunu meyvesine kavuştur.
gear-weapon#0098.flat: Sever every last impurity of the self, and bring to fruition a brilliant culmination of 'you'.

gear-weapon#0099.src: The world is a well of wonder. To open your eyes each day is the greatest gift that can be given. The strength of a thousand lives flows through your veins, and the world embraces you with a reckless, terrible, beautiful, incredible power.
gear-weapon#0099.dst: Dünya bir harikalar kuyusu. Her gün gözlerini açmak, verilebilecek en büyük armağan. Bin hayatın gücü damarlarında akıyor ve dünya seni pervasız, korkunç, güzel, inanılmaz bir güçle kucaklıyor.
gear-weapon#0099.flat: The world is a well of wonder. To open your eyes each day is the greatest gift that can be given. The strength of a thousand lives flows through your veins, and the world embraces you with a reckless, terrible, beautiful, incredible power.

gear-weapon#0100.src: I can't see this through to the end. I have to put my trust in you to finish it.
gear-weapon#0100.dst: Bunun sonunu göremeyeceğim. Bitirmen için sana güvenmek zorundayım.
gear-weapon#0100.flat: I can't see this through to the end. I have to put my trust in you to finish it.

gear-weapon#0101.src: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of {p}. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'
gear-weapon#0101.dst: Bu altın asa {p} mezarlarının derinliklerinden çıkarıldı. Odada şu sözler dışında hiçbir şey bulunamadı: 'Sınırsız hayal gücüne sahip kullanıcıdan sakının.'
gear-weapon#0101.flat: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of {p}. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'
gear-weapon#0101._raw: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of Almuj. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'

gear-weapon#0102.src: This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.
gear-weapon#0102.dst: Bu süslü yay uğursuz bir güzellik taşır. Her yeniden keşfi, onu alt etmeye çalışan her güce karşı yaklaşan bir felaketin habercisidir. Kaderin kaçınılmazlığı budur: kitlelerin iradesine kulak asmaz, bir çağ yeniden başlar.
gear-weapon#0102.flat: This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.

gear-weapon#0103.src: No one expected the WynnExcavation volcanic site to produce any valuable materials, but this heavy, obsidian-blend bow silenced the critics.
gear-weapon#0103.dst: Kimse WynnExcavation volkanik kazı alanından değerli bir malzeme çıkmasını beklemiyordu; ama obsidyen karışımlı bu ağır yay eleştirmenleri susturdu.
gear-weapon#0103.flat: No one expected the WynnExcavation volcanic site to produce any valuable materials, but this heavy, obsidian-blend bow silenced the critics.

gear-weapon#0104.src: The end comes in threes: first a deep and neverending shadow, suffocating all within its grasp. Then, a piercing blinding radiance, overtaking all within its sight. Finally, the in-between: chaos, bloodshed, war, a conflict which will sweep the land. Each end inevitable; but none a guarantee.
gear-weapon#0104.dst: Son üç adımda gelir: önce derin ve bitmeyen bir gölge, pençesindeki her şeyi boğar. Sonra delip geçen, kör edici bir parıltı, gördüğü her şeyi ele geçirir. Son olarak ikisinin arası: kaos, kan dökülmesi, savaş; toprakları silip süpürecek bir çatışma. Her son kaçınılmaz; ama hiçbiri garanti değil.
gear-weapon#0104.flat: The end comes in threes: first a deep and neverending shadow, suffocating all within its grasp. Then, a piercing blinding radiance, overtaking all within its sight. Finally, the in-between: chaos, bloodshed, war, a conflict which will sweep the land. Each end inevitable; but none a guarantee.

gear-weapon#0105.src: Supposedly based off of the wand of master mage Ethe, this wand is plated with magic-focusing jewels and heavy gold, yet somehow remains entirely weightless.
gear-weapon#0105.dst: Usta büyücü Ethe'nin asasından esinlendiği söylenen bu asa, büyüyü odaklayan mücevherler ve ağır altınla kaplıdır; yine de bir şekilde tamamen ağırlıksız kalır.
gear-weapon#0105.flat: Supposedly based off of the wand of master mage Ethe, this wand is plated with magic-focusing jewels and heavy gold, yet somehow remains entirely weightless.

gear-weapon#0106.src: When really does the point of no return come? Is it a gentle tug, whispers ushering you calmly to the other side? Is it a stark line, the point between light and dark, life and death? Perhaps you'll find out. Perhaps you already know.
gear-weapon#0106.dst: Dönüşü olmayan nokta gerçekte ne zaman gelir? Seni sakince öbür tarafa yönlendiren fısıltılarla hafif bir çekiş mi? Işıkla karanlık, yaşamla ölüm arasındaki keskin bir çizgi mi? Belki öğrenirsin. Belki zaten biliyorsun.
gear-weapon#0106.flat: When really does the point of no return come? Is it a gentle tug, whispers ushering you calmly to the other side? Is it a stark line, the point between light and dark, life and death? Perhaps you'll find out. Perhaps you already know.

gear-weapon#0107.src: Linked by blood, common cause, or pure fate, the clan is an immutable unit. Hundreds of hearts, beating as one, a collective pulse with the power to shake the world to its core.
gear-weapon#0107.dst: Kanla, ortak davayla ya da saf kaderle bağlanan klan değişmez bir bütündür. Tek bir kalp gibi atan yüzlerce kalp; dünyayı temelinden sarsacak güçte ortak bir nabız.
gear-weapon#0107.flat: Linked by blood, common cause, or pure fate, the clan is an immutable unit. Hundreds of hearts, beating as one, a collective pulse with the power to shake the world to its core.

gear-weapon#0108.src: "Not every spider is venomous, but do you really want to get bitten by them all to figure out which are?" -Alvin, Nivla Forest Resident
gear-weapon#0108.dst: "Her örümcek zehirli değil, ama hangilerinin zehirli olduğunu anlamak için hepsine ısırılmak ister misin?" -Alvin, Nivla Ormanı Sakini
gear-weapon#0108.flat: "Not every spider is venomous, but do you really want to get bitten by them all to figure out which are?" -Alvin, Nivla Forest Resident

gear-weapon#0109.src: The confusion of sentience creates unknown and marvelous threads and soundscapes. Joy, grief, hate, love, shock, calm, they reflect back into the pattern and song of the universe. The glow of the Weave, and this brilliant, breathtaking, pale imitation of it, too, resounds in the chorus of existence-one extra layer.
gear-weapon#0109.dst: Bilincin karmaşası bilinmedik ve harika iplikler, ses manzaraları yaratır. Neşe, keder, nefret, sevgi, şok, huzur; hepsi evrenin desenine ve şarkısına geri yansır. Weave'in ışıltısı ve onun bu parlak, nefes kesici, soluk taklidi de varoluşun korosunda yankılanır; fazladan bir katman.
gear-weapon#0109.flat: The confusion of sentience creates unknown and marvelous threads and soundscapes. Joy, grief, hate, love, shock, calm, they reflect back into the pattern and song of the universe. The glow of the Weave, and this brilliant, breathtaking, pale imitation of it, too, resounds in the chorus of existence-one extra layer.

gear-weapon#0110.src: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.
gear-weapon#0110.dst: Lero adında bir büyücü, yıldırımın saf gücünü büyülü bir asayla dizginlediğini iddia ediyor; ne var ki silah sıkışık anlarda hiç güvenilir değil.
gear-weapon#0110.flat: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.

gear-weapon#0111.src: A brilliant waltz on the razor's edge. Dance, dance through the fields of broken bodies and the vacant cities of empty people. Become the inevitable; the hands of time announce your interminable arrival. Raise your symphony to a crescendo, now: you are the dealer, and fate is the deck. The whole world will know your song.
gear-weapon#0111.dst: Usturanın ağzında parlak bir vals. Dans et, kırık bedenlerle dolu tarlalarda ve boş insanların ıssız şehirlerinde dans et. Kaçınılmaz ol; zamanın akrebi yelkovanı bitmeyen gelişini duyursun. Senfonini şimdi doruğa çıkar: dağıtan sensin, kader de deste. Bütün dünya şarkını bilecek.
gear-weapon#0111.flat: A brilliant waltz on the razor's edge. Dance, dance through the fields of broken bodies and the vacant cities of empty people. Become the inevitable; the hands of time announce your interminable arrival. Raise your symphony to a crescendo, now: you are the dealer, and fate is the deck. The whole world will know your song.

gear-weapon#0112.src: Once a contract is formed, and before its details are discussed, a seal is placed on the human's body.
gear-weapon#0112.dst: Bir sözleşme yapıldığında, ayrıntıları konuşulmadan önce insanın bedenine bir mühür vurulur.
gear-weapon#0112.flat: Once a contract is formed, and before its details are discussed, a seal is placed on the human's body.

gear-weapon#0113.src: Every time this spear hits an enemy, a sharp electrical jolt hits the users hands that forces powerful lightning to release.
gear-weapon#0113.dst: Bu mızrak bir düşmana her çarptığında kullanıcının ellerine keskin bir elektrik şoku iner ve güçlü bir yıldırımı serbest bırakır.
gear-weapon#0113.flat: Every time this spear hits an enemy, a sharp electrical jolt hits the users hands that forces powerful lightning to release.

gear-weapon#0114.src: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the {p}.
gear-weapon#0114.dst: {p} bölgesinin en nadir metallerinden dövülen korkunç, ateşli mızrak yalnızca Gavel ordusunun en şerefli savaşçılarına verilir.
gear-weapon#0114.flat: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the {p}.
gear-weapon#0114._raw: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the Molten Heights.

gear-weapon#0115.src: Gunpowder is your favourite scent. It signals peace: the enemies have been blown to high hell. And who doesn't love peace?
gear-weapon#0115.dst: En sevdiğin koku barut. Barışın habercisi: düşmanlar cehennemin dibine uçurulmuş. Kim barışı sevmez ki?
gear-weapon#0115.flat: Gunpowder is your favourite scent. It signals peace: the enemies have been blown to high hell. And who doesn't love peace?

gear-weapon#0116.src: A defiant pang joins the ruckus, a tune to run counter to the pain and the chaos of the rest. The strings of the forest are played just so, and the fall of each leaf echoes in an enchanted rhythm.
gear-weapon#0116.dst: Gürültüye meydan okuyan bir sızı katılır; geri kalanın acısına ve kaosuna karşı akan bir ezgi. Ormanın telleri tam kıvamında çalınır ve düşen her yaprak büyülü bir ritimle yankılanır.
gear-weapon#0116.flat: A defiant pang joins the ruckus, a tune to run counter to the pain and the chaos of the rest. The strings of the forest are played just so, and the fall of each leaf echoes in an enchanted rhythm.

gear-weapon#0117.src: Dwarven folklore tells of this mighty maul, used by gods to break mountains, shape continents, and crack the earth to form caverns.
gear-weapon#0117.dst: Cüce halk hikâyeleri, tanrıların dağları kırmak, kıtaları şekillendirmek ve mağaralar oluşturmak için toprağı yarmakta kullandığı bu kudretli tokmaktan söz eder.
gear-weapon#0117.flat: Dwarven folklore tells of this mighty maul, used by gods to break mountains, shape continents, and crack the earth to form caverns.

gear-weapon#0118.src: An attempt to penetrate the depths of the abyss; a sacrifice made to a futile end. No avail. Bloodshed paved the way for bloodshed, and evil still operates while blind.
gear-weapon#0118.dst: Uçurumun derinliklerine nüfuz etme girişimi; boş bir amaç için verilmiş bir kurban. Nafile. Kan dökülmesi kan dökülmesine yol açtı ve kötülük kör hâlde de işini sürdürüyor.
gear-weapon#0118.flat: An attempt to penetrate the depths of the abyss; a sacrifice made to a futile end. No avail. Bloodshed paved the way for bloodshed, and evil still operates while blind.

gear-weapon#0119.src: Found abandoned in the ruins of the Doguns, these odd weapons are designed to shoot jets of sheer flame instead of hitting enemies traditionally. They are in terrible disrepair, and none know how to fix them.
gear-weapon#0119.dst: Dogunların harabelerinde terk edilmiş hâlde bulunan bu tuhaf silahlar, düşmanlara alışıldık şekilde vurmak yerine saf alev fışkırtmak üzere tasarlanmış. Berbat hâldeler ve kimse onları nasıl onaracağını bilmiyor.
gear-weapon#0119.flat: Found abandoned in the ruins of the Doguns, these odd weapons are designed to shoot jets of sheer flame instead of hitting enemies traditionally. They are in terrible disrepair, and none know how to fix them.

gear-weapon#0121.src: A hovercraft scrounged from voidstone. Stained glass dulled to bleak grays. Blueprints and notes in indecipherable tongues. Moments, lost in time-like so  much refuse from the world above.
gear-weapon#0121.dst: Boşluk taşından derme çatma yapılmış bir hava aracı. Kasvetli grilere solmuş vitraylar. Çözülemeyen dillerde planlar ve notlar. Zamanda kaybolmuş anlar; yukarıdaki dünyadan düşen onca çöp gibi.
gear-weapon#0121.flat: A hovercraft scrounged from voidstone. Stained glass dulled to bleak grays. Blueprints and notes in indecipherable tongues. Moments, lost in time-like so  much refuse from the world above.

gear-weapon#0122.src: Curious, isn't it, that unending complexity can feel so plain in one's hand, yet pull deeper than eyes can see and minds can fathom?
gear-weapon#0122.dst: Tuhaf değil mi; bitmeyen bir karmaşıklık elde bu kadar sade hissettirebiliyor, yine de gözlerin göremeyeceği, akılların kavrayamayacağı derinliklere çekiyor?
gear-weapon#0122.flat: Curious, isn't it, that unending complexity can feel so plain in one's hand, yet pull deeper than eyes can see and minds can fathom?

gear-weapon#0123.src: Freedom of soul, mind, and body are forced upon all those that this bow's arrows impact, and freedom of caring from the atrocities that such a dangerous weapon can inflict is given to all those that hold it.
gear-weapon#0123.dst: Bu yayın oklarının değdiği herkese ruhun, aklın ve bedenin özgürlüğü zorla verilir; onu tutan herkese de böylesine tehlikeli bir silahın yol açabileceği vahşeti umursamama özgürlüğü bahşedilir.
gear-weapon#0123.flat: Freedom of soul, mind, and body are forced upon all those that this bow's arrows impact, and freedom of caring from the atrocities that such a dangerous weapon can inflict is given to all those that hold it.

gear-weapon#0124.src: It invites you to ride on the warm, soothing gusts it summons. It calls for you to admire the fires it leaves behind, burning the land to a char in its wake. It offers a lifetime of protection, while weaving a tapestry of flames across the world.
gear-weapon#0124.dst: Çağırdığı sıcak, yatıştırıcı rüzgârlara binmeye davet ediyor seni. Ardında bıraktığı, toprağı kömüre çeviren ateşleri hayranlıkla izlemeye çağırıyor. Dünyaya alevlerden bir dokuma örerken sana ömür boyu koruma vaat ediyor.
gear-weapon#0124.flat: It invites you to ride on the warm, soothing gusts it summons. It calls for you to admire the fires it leaves behind, burning the land to a char in its wake. It offers a lifetime of protection, while weaving a tapestry of flames across the world.

gear-weapon#0125.src: The Dernel tribes revere various nature deities, each in their own unique fashions. One of the most notable was that of a lost tribe, who fashioned this blossoming stave as tribute to their deity of the earth itself.
gear-weapon#0125.dst: Dernel kabileleri çeşitli doğa tanrılarına her biri kendine özgü biçimde tapar. En dikkat çekenlerden biri, toprağın ta kendisinin tanrısına adak olarak bu çiçek açan değneği yapan kayıp bir kabileydi.
gear-weapon#0125.flat: The Dernel tribes revere various nature deities, each in their own unique fashions. One of the most notable was that of a lost tribe, who fashioned this blossoming stave as tribute to their deity of the earth itself.

gear-weapon#0126.src: Those who have used this near-weightless bow all seem to tell tales of how they see Gale's spirit fighting alongside them.
gear-weapon#0126.dst: Neredeyse ağırlıksız bu yayı kullananların hepsi, Gale'in ruhunu yanlarında savaşırken gördüklerini anlatıyor.
gear-weapon#0126.flat: Those who have used this near-weightless bow all seem to tell tales of how they see Gale's spirit fighting alongside them.

gear-weapon#0127.src: Well...it is a very pretty-looking stick, but aside from that it just appears to be a plain old stick.
gear-weapon#0127.dst: Şey... çok güzel görünümlü bir sopa, ama onun dışında sıradan, eski bir sopadan farkı yok gibi.
gear-weapon#0127.flat: Well...it is a very pretty-looking stick, but aside from that it just appears to be a plain old stick.

gear-weapon#0128.src: Used for endurance training on the Icy Islands, this bow forces the wielder's body temperature to drop to near-hypothermic levels.
gear-weapon#0128.dst: Icy Islands'ta dayanıklılık eğitimi için kullanılan bu yay, sahibinin vücut sıcaklığını neredeyse hipotermi seviyesine düşürür.
gear-weapon#0128.flat: Used for endurance training on the Icy Islands, this bow forces the wielder's body temperature to drop to near-hypothermic levels.

gear-weapon#0129.src: The blazing sun has been revered by many druidic sects as a god in its own right, and the jewel in this brilliant wand glows with the brightness of their holy star.
gear-weapon#0129.dst: Yakıcı güneş pek çok druid tarikatınca başlı başına bir tanrı olarak kutsanır; bu parlak asadaki mücevher de onların kutsal yıldızının parlaklığıyla ışıldar.
gear-weapon#0129.flat: The blazing sun has been revered by many druidic sects as a god in its own right, and the jewel in this brilliant wand glows with the brightness of their holy star.

gear-weapon#0130.src: Pitch black and tipped with golden bands, it appears to grow at its wielder's whim. Strange runes are etched into the side, that flash with a heavenly light.
gear-weapon#0130.dst: Kapkara ve uçları altın bantlı; sahibinin isteğine göre uzuyor gibi. Yanına, ilahi bir ışıkla parlayan tuhaf rünler kazınmış.
gear-weapon#0130.flat: Pitch black and tipped with golden bands, it appears to grow at its wielder's whim. Strange runes are etched into the side, that flash with a heavenly light.

gear-weapon#0131.src: The stalwart Guard Golems stand as the protectors of Wynn's cities. To wield the remains of one so viciously dismembered by the undead... just how deadly are these hordes?It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0131.dst: Sadık Muhafız Golemler, Wynn şehirlerinin koruyucuları olarak dimdik durur. Ölümsüzlerin böylesine vahşice parçaladığı birinin kalıntılarını kuşanmak... bu sürüler ne kadar ölümcül acaba?Seni bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-weapon#0131.flat: The stalwart Guard Golems stand as the protectors of Wynn's cities. To wield the remains of one so viciously dismembered by the undead... just how deadly are these hordes?It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0132.src: Little spikes of corruption grow out of the blades on this weapon, serrating it. They seem to grow after drawing blood, guiding your body to dig further into the enemy's viscera even after they've already died.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0132.dst: Bu silahın ağızlarından küçük yozlaşma dikenleri çıkıp onu testere gibi dişliyor. Kan aldıktan sonra büyüyor gibiler; düşman çoktan ölmüş olsa bile bedenini onun bağırsaklarına daha da derin gömmeye yönlendiriyorlar.Seni bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-weapon#0132.flat: Little spikes of corruption grow out of the blades on this weapon, serrating it. They seem to grow after drawing blood, guiding your body to dig further into the enemy's viscera even after they've already died.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0133.src: It's a gravity as abstract as it is physical, of phenomena so fascinating one can't help but be pulled in.
gear-weapon#0133.dst: Fiziksel olduğu kadar soyut da bir çekim bu; öyle büyüleyici olgulardan doğar ki insan içine çekilmeden edemez.
gear-weapon#0133.flat: It's a gravity as abstract as it is physical, of phenomena so fascinating one can't help but be pulled in.

gear-weapon#0134.src: The very first crossbow in existence was claimed to be utterly indestructible, but it is only true to a fault. The item cannot be broken, but solely because all damage to it is instead reflected onto the user. As its age is uncountably ancient, wielders will find themselves rapidly aging and withering away with even a mere touch.
gear-weapon#0134.dst: Var olan ilk arbaletin tamamen yok edilemez olduğu iddia edilirdi; ama bu ancak bir kusur pahasına doğrudur. Eşya kırılamaz, çünkü ona verilen bütün hasar kullanıcıya yansır. Yaşı hesaplanamayacak kadar eski olduğundan, sahipleri en ufak bir dokunuşla bile hızla yaşlanıp eriyip gider.
gear-weapon#0134.flat: The very first crossbow in existence was claimed to be utterly indestructible, but it is only true to a fault. The item cannot be broken, but solely because all damage to it is instead reflected onto the user. As its age is uncountably ancient, wielders will find themselves rapidly aging and withering away with even a mere touch.

gear-weapon#0135.src: Found at the site of the {p}, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.
gear-weapon#0135.dst: {p} alanında bulunan bu eldiveni takan herkese bir lanet çöker: yaralarında irinlenen bir beden çürümesi ve bütün düşünceleri bulandıran bir zihin çürümesi. Onunla birlikte bir düşünce kök salar: birlikte acı çekmek, artık acı çekmemektir.
gear-weapon#0135.flat: Found at the site of the {p}, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.
gear-weapon#0135._raw: Found at the site of the Caritat Mansion, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.

gear-weapon#0136.src: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.
gear-weapon#0136.dst: Artık efsanevi bir kadın kahramanın ruhunun yaşadığı bu mızrağın üzerinde bir koruma yemini asılı. Yanan ağzına bir kez bakmak bile koruma ve güven duygusu aşılar; kuşanacak kadar cesur olan için bu duygu gerçeğe dönüşür.
gear-weapon#0136.flat: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.

gear-weapon#0137.src: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.
gear-weapon#0137.dst: Hiç görülmemiş bir deniz yaratığının bilinmeyen parçalarından oyulmuş bu derinlik heykelinin dev pulları... bir çekim getiriyor. Bir ağırlık, bir basınç. Sahibine çöken, onu hasret gibi saran korkunç, ezici bir derinlik. Asıl sahibi izliyor; bir parçası eksik parçalarının acı biçimde farkında.
gear-weapon#0137.flat: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.

gear-weapon#0138.src: As a flashing star shot through the night sky, a sole observer witnessed its brilliance. It was then, wreathed in prismatic light, he decided. Someday, he would shine as bright as that star, and overtake those beneath him. No matter the cost.
gear-weapon#0138.dst: Gece göğünde bir yıldız kayarken tek bir gözlemci onun parlaklığına tanık oldu. Prizmatik ışığa sarılmışken karar verdi: bir gün o yıldız kadar parlak parlayacak ve altındakileri geride bırakacaktı. Bedeli ne olursa olsun.
gear-weapon#0138.flat: As a flashing star shot through the night sky, a sole observer witnessed its brilliance. It was then, wreathed in prismatic light, he decided. Someday, he would shine as bright as that star, and overtake those beneath him. No matter the cost.

gear-weapon#0139.src: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.
gear-weapon#0139.dst: En tehlikeli düşman göremediğin düşmandır. Bir yaprak savruntusunun arasına gizlenmiş bir darbe çığı gelir; bir an dağları ve ormanları büyüyen bir karışıma eritir, bir sonraki an ardında canlı bir çiçek izi bırakır.
gear-weapon#0139.flat: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.

gear-weapon#0140.src: The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.
gear-weapon#0140.dst: Charon'un Terk Edilmiş Lejyonu'nun dışlanmış kayıkçısı Haros'un yıpranmış küreği. Gümüş sırığa derme çatma büyülü aletler takılmış; kemikli avucunun dışında donuk donuk parlıyorlar.
gear-weapon#0140.flat: The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.

gear-weapon#0141.src: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from {p} were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.
gear-weapon#0141.dst: Ses kaydedebilen bir eşya yaratan ilk teknoloji Corkus teknolojisi değildi. {p} kaynaklı eserlerin ortam seslerini kaydedip  kulak patlatan ses patlamalarına dönüştürdüğü  keşfedildi.
gear-weapon#0141.flat: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from {p} were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.
gear-weapon#0141._raw: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from Time Valley were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.

gear-weapon#0142.src: The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.
gear-weapon#0142.dst: Mızrağa oyulmuş rünler öyle hızlı şekil değiştirir ki okunamaz; ama onu kuşananların anlamlarını öğreneceği söylenir.
gear-weapon#0142.flat: The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.

gear-weapon#0143.src: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside."   -Attributed to Hashr
gear-weapon#0143.dst: "İhanet akrebin kuyruğundan daha keskin sokar ve içindeki zehirden daha kötü irinlenir."   -Hashr'a atfedilir
gear-weapon#0143.flat: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside."   -Attributed to Hashr

gear-weapon#0144.src: Everything slowly loses heat, and will eventually stop moving. Are you prepared?
gear-weapon#0144.dst: Her şey yavaş yavaş ısısını kaybeder ve sonunda hareket etmeyi bırakır. Hazır mısın?
gear-weapon#0144.flat: Everything slowly loses heat, and will eventually stop moving. Are you prepared?

gear-weapon#0145.src: Among the outcasts of {p}, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.
gear-weapon#0145.dst: {p} dışlanmışları arasında bazıları ölümden korkulmaması gerektiğini vaaz eder. Kapısına giden yol cehennem gibi, habercisi de son derece zalim olsa da öte tarafın affettiğini söylerler. Bu yaldızlı mızrakta yalnızca bir silah değil, bir anahtar, bir bilet görüyorsun. Ne yapacağını biliyorsun. Haberci ol.
gear-weapon#0145.flat: Among the outcasts of {p}, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.
gear-weapon#0145._raw: Among the outcasts of Efilim, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. gear-weapon#0146.src: For the hundreds sacrificed for {p}'s survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0146.dst: {p} hayatta kalsın diye kurban edilen yüzlerce kişi için ölüm son değildi. Arta kalan kara büyü ve yozlaşmış enerji, bu silahta huzurdan mahrum bırakılan kurbanların keder ve ıstırabının soluk yankıları olarak belirir.Seni bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-weapon#0146.flat: For the hundreds sacrificed for {p}'s survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0146._raw: For the hundreds sacrificed for Troms's survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0147.src: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.
gear-weapon#0147.dst: Alevlere kararlı gözlerle bak. Kükürdün dibine bir kez indin mi geri dönüş yok.
gear-weapon#0147.flat: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.

gear-weapon#0148.src: This profane bow was crafted by a Kander cabal in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.
gear-weapon#0148.dst: Bu kutsal olmayan yay, House of Talor'un kutsal emanetine karşı bir Kander tarikatı tarafından yapıldı. Uzun süre tutmak, kullanıcının zihnini zorlar ve çarpıtır.
gear-weapon#0148.flat: This profane bow was crafted by a Kander cabal in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.

gear-weapon#0149.src: One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.
gear-weapon#0149.dst: Skien'in pek çok ölümcül silahından biri. Başının devasa ağırlığına rağmen Skien bu savaş çekicini bulanık görünecek kadar hızlı savurabiliyordu.
gear-weapon#0149.flat: One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.

gear-weapon#0150.src: Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.
gear-weapon#0150.dst: Eski hâlinin tahta kırıntılarından yeniden yapılan bu son derece ağır arbalet hâlâ muazzam bir güç barındırıyor. Kayıp bir zırh takımıyla kullanılmak üzere yapılmıştı; o takımdan geriye tek bir parça kaldı.
gear-weapon#0150.flat: Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.

gear-weapon#0151.src: The calm before the storm is a time of preparation, of perseverance until clearer days. But this? This is the last moment of peace they will ever know.
gear-weapon#0151.dst: Fırtına öncesi sessizlik bir hazırlık, daha aydınlık günlere dek bir sabır zamanıdır. Ama bu mu? Bu, bilecekleri son huzur anı.
gear-weapon#0151.flat: The calm before the storm is a time of preparation, of perseverance until clearer days. But this? This is the last moment of peace they will ever know.

gear-weapon#0152.src: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.
gear-weapon#0152.dst: Esrarengiz biçimde bu silah yalnızca kendini değersiz ya da zayıf sanan kişilere görünür. Kullanmak kişinin kararlılığını büyük ölçüde güçlendirir; ama artık ihtiyaç kalmadığında kaybolur ve bir sonraki sahibine gider.
gear-weapon#0152.flat: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.

gear-weapon#0153.src: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.
gear-weapon#0153.dst: Yaklaşan felaket ve bitmeyen serpinti armağanını alışlarını izle.
gear-weapon#0153.flat: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.

gear-weapon#0154.src: To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.
gear-weapon#0154.dst: En nefret dolu enerjileri yatıştırmak, en dengesiz iradeleri odaklamak, en yabancı sesleri anlamak, en umursamaz güçleri sarsmak, en geçici potansiyeli yakalamak. Pek çok âlimin son eseri: dünyaya en saf hâliyle hükmetmek.
gear-weapon#0154.flat: To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.

gear-weapon#0155.src: "I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant
gear-weapon#0155.dst: "O örümcek kraliçesini bir kez gördüm. Evimi bulması an meselesiymiş gibi geldi, ben de buraya taşındım." -Babhla, Nivla Kâse Tüccarı
gear-weapon#0155.flat: "I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant

gear-weapon#0156.src: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.
gear-weapon#0156.dst: Rüzgârlar tuhaf şeylerdir. Hafif esinti yatıştırıcı ve hoştur. Bora bir çocuğun huysuzluğu gibi savurur, kırıp döker. Gerçekten yıkan yalnızca fırtınadır; yoluna çıkan herkese ve her şeye esip geriye yalnızca harabe ve toz bırakır.
gear-weapon#0156.flat: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.

gear-weapon#0157.src: A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.
gear-weapon#0157.dst: Okyanusun elementlerinden yapılmış bir kılıç. Düşmanları gelgitin zarafetiyle biçer.
gear-weapon#0157.flat: A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.

gear-weapon#0158.src: Only years of training, of building tolerance, has allowed you resistance to the onslaught; channeling the unstoppability of a torrent unleashed. Your enemy stands no chance.
gear-weapon#0158.dst: Yıllarca süren eğitim ve dayanıklılık kazanma süreci, bu saldırıya direnmeni sağladı; salıverilmiş bir selin durdurulamazlığını yönlendiriyorsun. Düşmanının hiç şansı yok.
gear-weapon#0158.flat: Only years of training, of building tolerance, has allowed you resistance to the onslaught; channeling the unstoppability of a torrent unleashed. Your enemy stands no chance.

gear-weapon#0159.src: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, {p} Priest
gear-weapon#0159.dst: "Ölüler hâlâ duyabiliyor. Bir ninninin onları biraz daha uyumaya ikna edebileceğini düşünüyorum." -Merloni, {p} Rahibi
gear-weapon#0159.flat: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, {p} Priest
gear-weapon#0159._raw: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, Saint's Row Priest

gear-weapon#0160.src: An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.
gear-weapon#0160.dst: Gücü tek bir elde toplama girişimi: bu amaçla bir eyalet boyunca silaha dönüştürülmüş servet. Bir kahraman başkaldırdı. Kristaller yandı ve planlar toza döndü.
gear-weapon#0160.flat: An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.

gear-weapon#0161.src: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the {p}. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.
gear-weapon#0161.dst: {p} sularından çıkarılan bu muhteşem üç dişli mızrağın sapını, adeta bir totem direğindeki gibi ince oymalar ve resimler kaplıyor. Yabancı büyüler savaşta kullanıcısının duyularını keskinleştirir ama içine bir okyanus özlemi de salar. Pek çoğu bu dürtüye yenik düşüp kendini boğdu.
gear-weapon#0161.flat: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the {p}. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.

gear-weapon#0162.src: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.
gear-weapon#0162.dst: Cücelerin Garaheth katliamında son darbeyi indirmek için kullandığı bu yay son derece güçlüdür. Kullanıcının yanmaması için her zaman özel ateşe dayanıklı eldivenler takılmalıdır.
gear-weapon#0162.flat: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.

gear-weapon#0163.src: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the {p} hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.
gear-weapon#0163.dst: {p} bölgesinin efsanevi Altın Ninjası, Ozoth'tan kesilen alevli pullarla dövülmüş, hafif ama çelikten sert bu kargıyla avının peşini hiç bırakmazdı.
gear-weapon#0163.flat: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the {p} hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.
gear-weapon#0163._raw: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the Canyon of the Lost hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.

gear-weapon#0164.dst: "Uydurmuyorum! O örümcek YÜZÜME ışınlandı!" -Stiba, Element Araştırmacısı
gear-weapon#0164.flat: "I am not making this up! That spider teleported ONTO MY FACE!" -Stiba, Elemental Researcher

gear-weapon#0165.src: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.
gear-weapon#0165.dst: Kendini yakmak asla hafife alınmaz ve her zaman bir fedakârlıktır. Bu put, böyle bir anı onurlandırmak için oyuldu: bir ateş ustası, son bir kahramanlıkla yaşam gücünü yakıp tüketti; ilerleyen bir ölümsüz ordusunu temizleyip cengel halkını yok olmaktan kurtardı.
gear-weapon#0165.flat: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.

gear-weapon#0166.src: Prolonged exposure to the corruption may cause sudden bursts of madness in soldiers. To assure themselves of their sanity, some have even begun to play tricks on their brethren.
gear-weapon#0166.dst: Yozlaşmaya uzun süre maruz kalmak askerlerde ani delilik nöbetlerine yol açabilir. Akıllarının yerinde olduğundan emin olmak için bazıları silah arkadaşlarına şaka yapmaya bile başladı.
gear-weapon#0166.flat: Prolonged exposure to the corruption may cause sudden bursts of madness in soldiers. To assure themselves of their sanity, some have even begun to play tricks on their brethren.

gear-weapon#0167.src: She wears a dozen masks, each fragile as the surface of a lake. The shards of her discarded personage are sharp enough to kill.
gear-weapon#0167.dst: Bir düzine maske takar, her biri göl yüzeyi kadar kırılgan. Attığı kimliklerin kırıkları öldürecek kadar keskindir.
gear-weapon#0167.flat: She wears a dozen masks, each fragile as the surface of a lake. The shards of her discarded personage are sharp enough to kill.

gear-weapon#0168.src: Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.
gear-weapon#0168.dst: Binlerce yıl boyunca boşluk deliklerinin derinliklerinde hapis kalan bu kadim emanet, kendi yokluğuyla tanınmaz hâle gelecek kadar çarpılmış. Döndüğünde gerçekliğe yeniden karışmak yerine, anlaşılamayan bir dünyadan kopmanın çılgın hâlini de beraberinde getiriyor.
gear-weapon#0168.flat: Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.

gear-weapon#0169.src: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.
gear-weapon#0169.dst: Bu asayı tutarken kendini daha az . . . bedensel hissediyorsun. Daha az gerçek. Rüzgâr içinden geçiyor, yanından esip gidiyor; sanki bu dünya hiç senin için yapılmamış gibi.
gear-weapon#0169.flat: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.

gear-weapon#0170.src: A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.
gear-weapon#0170.dst: Sock Brewing laboratuvarlarından tuhaf bir prototip; bu içkili heykele bakmak bile baş dönmesine, çakırkeyifliğe ve kısa süre sonra da yalnızca içkinin uyandırabildiği o tanıdık çılgınlığa yol açar.
gear-weapon#0170.flat: A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.

gear-weapon#0171.src: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of {p}. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.
gear-weapon#0171.dst: Dogun Tanrısı Garaheth aslında {p} bölgesinin bağırlarında yaşayan devasa bir ateş iblisiydi. Pek akıllıca olmasa da Cüceler, onun katledilişini kutlamak için dişinden şeytani bir hançer dövdü.
gear-weapon#0171.flat: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of {p}. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.
gear-weapon#0171._raw: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of Molten Heights. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.

gear-weapon#0172.src: From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0172.dst: Kordan yangına, Savaş'ın alevleri sonsuza dek titreşir.Seni bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-weapon#0172.flat: From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0173.src: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.
gear-weapon#0173.dst: En küçük taşı oymak ya da en küçük kilidi açmak gerektiğinde, hassasiyetin incelikleri imkânsıza yaklaşır.
gear-weapon#0173.flat: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.

gear-weapon#0174.src: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.
gear-weapon#0174.dst: Sadağından ok almak için uzandığında tek bir okun bile olsa asla tükenmediğini görürsün.
gear-weapon#0174.flat: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.

gear-weapon#0175.src: This knife does not belong in your hands... yet somehow it feels right at home.
gear-weapon#0175.dst: Bu bıçağın senin ellerinde işi yok... ama nedense tam yerindeymiş gibi hissettiriyor.
gear-weapon#0175.flat: This knife does not belong in your hands... yet somehow it feels right at home.

gear-weapon#0176.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this bow has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its string radiates a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0176.dst: Aldatıcı derecede sade görünen bu yay, bilinen beş elementin hepsinin enerjisiyle aşılanmış. Kirişi renk yelpazesi saçar.
gear-weapon#0176.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this bow has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its string radiates a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0177.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this dagger has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It leaves afterimages that pulsate in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0177.dst: Aldatıcı derecede sade görünen bu hançer, bilinen beş elementin hepsinin enerjisiyle aşılanmış. Ardında renk yelpazesiyle titreşen izler bırakır.
gear-weapon#0177.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this dagger has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It leaves afterimages that pulsate in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0178.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this relik has been infused with energy from all five known elements. The head gleams in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0178.dst: Aldatıcı derecede sade görünen bu relik, bilinen beş elementin hepsinin enerjisiyle aşılanmış. Başı renk yelpazesiyle parıldar.
gear-weapon#0178.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this relik has been infused with energy from all five known elements. The head gleams in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0179.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this spear has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its tip shimmers in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0179.dst: Aldatıcı derecede sade görünen bu mızrak, bilinen beş elementin hepsinin enerjisiyle aşılanmış. Ucu renk yelpazesiyle ışıldar.
gear-weapon#0179.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this spear has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its tip shimmers in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0180.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this wand has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It subtly glows in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0180.dst: Aldatıcı derecede sade görünen bu asa, bilinen beş elementin hepsinin enerjisiyle aşılanmış. Renk yelpazesiyle hafifçe parlar.
gear-weapon#0180.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this wand has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It subtly glows in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0181.src: Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.
gear-weapon#0181.dst: Aşırı güç, uğruna çabalanacak bir ideal. Orantısız şiddet, korumakla yükümlü olduğun hakkın.
gear-weapon#0181.flat: Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.

gear-weapon#0182.src: They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.
gear-weapon#0182.dst: İnançlı evlerini yağmaladılar, kutsal tarlalarını yakıp yıktılar. Bu mızrağa kutsal gücün bir yansıması işlenmiş; onunla bu alçak günahkârların karşısına Cehennem'in kendisini çıkaracaksın.
gear-weapon#0182.flat: They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.

gear-weapon#0183.src: It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.
gear-weapon#0183.dst: Binlerce medeniyetin yükselişine ve çöküşüne tanık oldu. Milyonlarca yıldızın doğuşunu ve ölümünü gördü. Evrenlerin açılıp kapandığını izledi. İzliyor... sonsuzluğun her saniyesi geçerken.
gear-weapon#0183.flat: It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.

gear-weapon#0184.src: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.
gear-weapon#0184.dst: Hantal görünen bu eldivenler aslında son derece hafiftir; Elflerce kutsanmış büyülü bir demir alaşımından yapılmıştır.
gear-weapon#0184.flat: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.

gear-weapon#0185.src: Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.
gear-weapon#0185.dst: Çoğu kişi demirden yay yapmanın yavaş ve israf olacağını söyledi; ama demir okun ağırlığı taşı bile delebilir.
gear-weapon#0185.flat: Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.

gear-weapon#0186.src: The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.
gear-weapon#0186.dst: House of Talor'un kutsal kılıcı saf tek boynuzlu at boynuzlarından yapıldı ve yüz rahip tarafından kutsandı. Salt varlığı bile kötü ruhları kovar.
gear-weapon#0186.flat: The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.

gear-weapon#0187.src: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage
gear-weapon#0187.dst: "Yaprakların arasında bulacağın sarmaşıklardan harika halat olur!" -Alekin'in Bitki Liflerinden İp Yapım Rehberi
gear-weapon#0187.flat: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage

gear-weapon#0188.src: You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.
gear-weapon#0188.dst: Burayı tanımıyorsun. Yabancı duvarlardan bir labirent üzerine kapanıyor. Bin kez yürüdüğün yollar artık yabancı. Bunlar senin ellerin mi? Tanımadığın bir etten yapılmışlar.
gear-weapon#0188.flat: You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.

gear-weapon#0189.src: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only {~} emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -{p} Self-Defense Class Advertisement
gear-weapon#0189.dst: "Haydut saldırıları uykunu mu kaçırıyor? Burada ücretsiz dövüş dersleri! Yalnızca {~} Zümrüt; neye uğradıklarını şaşıracaklar!" -{p} Kendini Savunma Dersi İlanı
gear-weapon#0189.flat: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only {~} emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -{p} Self-Defense Class Advertisement
gear-weapon#0189._raw: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only 10 emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -Almuj Self-Defense Class Advertisement

gear-weapon#0190.src: Soldiers and sorcerers, mere men who think themselves judgement. Not so. Judgement is beyond the sword, beyond the staff; justice prefers different weapons. There is nothing, nothing at all, out of its reach.
gear-weapon#0190.dst: Askerler ve büyücüler, kendilerini yargı sanan sıradan adamlar. Öyle değil. Yargı kılıcın da, asanın da ötesindedir; adalet başka silahları yeğler. Erişemeyeceği hiçbir şey, ama hiçbir şey yoktur.
gear-weapon#0190.flat: Soldiers and sorcerers, mere men who think themselves judgement. Not so. Judgement is beyond the sword, beyond the staff; justice prefers different weapons. There is nothing, nothing at all, out of its reach.

gear-weapon#0191.src: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled {p} Resident
gear-weapon#0191.dst: "Misillemenin kanun olduğu yerde en güvenlisi hiçbir şey yapmamak gibi geliyor."  -Ormrod, Kendini Sürgün Etmiş {p} Sakini
gear-weapon#0191.flat: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled {p} Resident
gear-weapon#0191._raw: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled Almuj Resident

gear-weapon#0192.src: This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.
gear-weapon#0192.dst: Sahibine keskin görüş armağan eden bu yay, başkalarını kendi kör kaderinden korumaya kararlı kör bir demirci tarafından dövüldü.
gear-weapon#0192.flat: This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.

gear-weapon#0193.src: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right.  Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?
gear-weapon#0193.dst: Sol. Sağ. Sol. Sağ. Bir çıkış için çaresizler; senin tasarladığın bir labirentte oyuncaktan ibaretler. Sol. Sol. Sağ.  Geri dön. Taş dağlar senin emrinle yer değiştirebildiğinde, onların dünyası tek bir yola iner. Sol. Sağ. Hiç bitecek mi?
gear-weapon#0193.flat: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right.  Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?

gear-weapon#0194.src: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.
gear-weapon#0194.dst: Kayıp şehir Sarnfic derinliklere gömüldüğünde yüzeye çığlık kabarcıklarından ve bu tek asadan başka hiçbir şey çıkmadı. Kullandığında kasabanın ağıtını hâlâ duyabilirsin.
gear-weapon#0194.flat: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.

gear-weapon#0195.src: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.
gear-weapon#0195.dst: Görünmeyen ama öyle güzel bir öfke ki gözlerini üzerine diktiğin an salıverilmesi gerektiğini bildin. Bedeli ne olursa olsun.
gear-weapon#0195.flat: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.

gear-weapon#0196.src: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.
gear-weapon#0196.dst: Pek çoğu bu mızrağın özelliklerini kopyalamaya çalıştı; ama mızrak ucuna, mızrağın kendisini patlatmayan bir patlayıcı büyü işlemeyi başaran çok az kişi oldu.
gear-weapon#0196.flat: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.

"Against all heed, to Fruma eternal."

gear-weapon#0197.dst:
"Her uyarıya rağmen, ebedî Fruma'ya."

gear-weapon#0197.flat: "Against all heed, to Fruma eternal." The engraving appears extremely weathered.

gear-weapon#0198.src: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.
gear-weapon#0198.dst: Skien'in başkalarına olan güveni, bu hançerin sahibi yüzünden sonsuza dek paramparça oldu; o kişi büyük bir corrupted kuşatması sırasında yozlaşmaya yenik düşüp Skien'in lejyonuna saldırmıştı.
gear-weapon#0198.flat: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.

gear-weapon#0199.src: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!
gear-weapon#0199.dst: Adı kesin yanlış yazılmış... Hiçbir anlamı bile yok!
gear-weapon#0199.flat: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!

gear-weapon#0200.src: The once-chief of the Iboju tribe held a sacred duty: a revitalizing defense of the jungle, reducing smoldering bones of invaders to rich ash that fed the soil. Yet, as the undead plight wore on, duty curdled into obsession. He became the very monster he sought to destroy, seeing horrors in every living soul and purging them for a land he lost his mind to save.
gear-weapon#0200.dst: Iboju kabilesinin eski reisinin kutsal bir görevi vardı: cengeli canlandırarak savunmak, istilacıların için için yanan kemiklerini toprağı besleyen bereketli küle çevirmek. Ama ölümsüz belası sürdükçe görev saplantıya dönüştü. Yok etmeye çalıştığı canavarın ta kendisi oldu; her canlıda dehşet görüp, kurtarmak uğruna aklını yitirdiği bir toprak için onları temizledi.
gear-weapon#0200.flat: The once-chief of the Iboju tribe held a sacred duty: a revitalizing defense of the jungle, reducing smoldering bones of invaders to rich ash that fed the soil. Yet, as the undead plight wore on, duty curdled into obsession. He became the very monster he sought to destroy, seeing horrors in every living soul and purging them for a land he lost his mind to save.

gear-weapon#0201.src: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.
gear-weapon#0201.dst: Zarları at, kibriti çak. Asla ıskalamazsın.
gear-weapon#0201.flat: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.

gear-weapon#0202.src: The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.
gear-weapon#0202.dst: Deliliğin asıl gücü doğaüstü bir dinçlikten değil, birden kendini koruma isteğini kaybetmekten ve ardından gelen, ne istersen yapabilme yetisinden gelir.
gear-weapon#0202.flat: The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.

gear-weapon#0203.src: The mirror at the core of this artefact reflects back an image of a citadel that does not exist anywhere on this planet.
gear-weapon#0203.dst: Bu eserin merkezindeki ayna, bu gezegenin hiçbir yerinde var olmayan bir kalenin görüntüsünü yansıtır.
gear-weapon#0203.flat: The mirror at the core of this artefact reflects back an image of a citadel that does not exist anywhere on this planet.

gear-weapon#0204.src: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.
gear-weapon#0204.dst: Nether Kapısı'ndan bir kozmik taş parçası fırladı. Saflığı kirletildi ve onu ilk kuşanan adam, kozmosun güzelliğinin düşüşü hakkında sayıklayarak delirdi.
gear-weapon#0204.flat: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.

gear-weapon#0205.src: Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.
gear-weapon#0205.dst: Ruhun lekeli. Aldatmacanın kiri ve cinayetin çamuruyla kaplı; günahlar her adımında peşini bırakmıyor. Hepsini yakıp kül et, varlığını parlak bir ışık çakımında arındır.
gear-weapon#0205.flat: Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.

gear-weapon#0206.src: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of {p}
gear-weapon#0206.dst: "Bu Wynn eyaletini kasıp kavuran durumu ancak Gavel'deki en kötü ruhlular hayal edebilirdi." -{p} Kralı
gear-weapon#0206.flat: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of {p}
